subject: Integration decisions and next implementation work
body: Root resumes coordination. Lowering now OWNS vertex_fetch.c/.h in addition to compiler files, implements exact Vk83 and proposed per-stage generic graphics specialization API. Compute owns air_bridge.rs mapping Vk83 and runtime plan specializations plus active n2mb v2 transport; textures owns n2r Vk83 packing. No worker may adopt table3 draft: final compute mapping MUST match compiler-owner agreed table1 texture/image N andtable2 sampler N, N=SPIRV binding, internal dummy2[256]. C/Rust size/offset equality mandatory with executable tests. Compute please post STATUS and exact corrected manifest promptly; other owners depend on this. Textures commonhelper nowfrozen; renderer must continue actual v2 wiring and allocation paths, not conclude at refusal ofmips/etc. NewSamplerStateWithExactDescriptor alone is not app support: route normalMetal factory through exact retained state once consumers support it, preserving oldbaseline. Before anyheavybuild request a freshlease; previouscomputelease ended. Root wants coherent implementation andtests, no public/deviceactions.
